4.4.8
Prompt Builder
The prompt builder prepares a grounded prompt using retrieved chunks.
The prompt explicitly instructs the language model to answer only from retrieved
documents.
This minimizes hallucinations.
4.4.9
Language Model
The generated prompt is forwarded to Ollama running the Llama 3 model locally.
The LLM generates a context-aware response using only the supplied evidence.
4.4.10
Citation Module
The citation engine attaches:
• Document Name
• Page Number
• Chunk Number
• Similarity Score
This enables users to verify every generated response.
4.5
Advantages of the Architecture
The proposed architecture offers numerous benefits.
• Modular Design
• Easy Maintenance
• Secure Authentication
• Efficient Vector Search
• Grounded AI Responses
• Local LLM Execution
• Reduced Hallucination
• Scalable Deployment
• Support for Multiple Users
